name: Caac
region: Far North of New Caledonia (Pouébo area)
notes: A Far North language of New Caledonia, north of the isogloss beyond which intervocalic consonants are neutralised (Rivierre 1994: 509, Map 1). Consonants only, from Hollyman (1962) as tabulated by Rivierre (1994: 508, Table 1); no vowels are given. Finally only p, t, c, k and m, n, ɲ, ŋ occur (Table 1). Coordinates from Glottolog 5.4.
